category: Items Primarily Interpreted Visually for Information
explanation: Book, Map, Sheet Music, and X-ray are all forms of media or images that are primarily 'read' or visually interpreted to gain specific information. A Record Player is a device that *plays* audio information, rather than being a visual medium to be interpreted.

Four of these were among the Seven Ancient Wonders of the World that no longer exist, having been destroyed over time. The Great Pyramid of Giza is the only one of the original Seven Wonders that largely remains intact today.
Brilliant, Astute, Perceptive, and Sagacious are all adjectives used to describe someone with high intelligence or sharp mental ability. Luminous describes something that emits or reflects light.
